## Pursuit Signs Agreement to Acquire Sky Adventures, Advancing Growth Plans in Costa Rica


November 24, 2026


*Second acquisition expands Pursuit’s Costa Rica Collection, connecting hospitality, wellness, nature and adventure in the Arenal region*


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) (“Pursuit”) today announced it has signed an agreement to acquire Valle Monteverde S.A, operating as Sky Adventures (“Sky Adventures”), a highly regarded nature-based adventure attraction in Costa Rica’s Arenal region, advancing its growth strategy of investing in experiential infrastructure in iconic destinations with strong perennial demand.


Sky Adventures, Costa Rica.


Sky Adventures will be Pursuit's second acquisition in Costa Rica, following Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa ("Tabacón”) in July 2025, and represents a significant next step in expanding Pursuit's Costa Rica Collection. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approval, and is anticipated to close in early 2027.


Founded in 1997, Sky Adventures has a strong reputation for high-quality nature and adventure experiences, guest satisfaction and safety. Its experiences include zipline circuits, an aerial tram, hanging bridges and rainforest exploration, with sweeping views of Arenal Volcano, Lake Arenal and the surrounding landscape. Behind it all is an experienced local team with deep knowledge of the destination and a longstanding commitment to environmental stewardship.


The acquisition advances Pursuit’s strategy of owning and operating distinctive, place-based experiences in iconic destinations with strong, perennial demand. Located just 15 minutes from Tabacón, Sky Adventures’ nature and adventure offering complements the resort’s hospitality and thermal wellness experience, creating opportunities for guests to connect more deeply with the Arenal region with continued investment in the guest experience over time.


“We are excited to take another significant step in expanding Pursuit’s presence in Costa Rica with an agreement to acquire a highly regarded business and exceptional guest experience,” said David Barry, president and chief executive officer of Pursuit. “Together with Tabacón, Sky Adventures will allow us to serve more of the guest journey through Costa Rica’s iconic Arenal region with meaningful opportunities for cross-marketing and future growth. We believe Costa Rica is an attractive market for Pursuit, and we intend to continue building our collection there through disciplined investment.”


“Sky Adventures has earned a strong reputation for the quality of its guest experience and the way it brings adventures in the Arenal region to life,” said Andrey Gomez, General Manager, Tabacón. “We have a lot of respect for what the team has built over nearly three decades and, following closing, we’re excited to work closely together to build on that foundation and deliver exceptional experiences for visitors to Arenal.”


Pursuit has provided supplemental information related to this transaction for investors on Pursuit’s website under[Investors/Events & Presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.pursuit.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54645875&newsitemid=20261124041337&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors%2FEvents+%26amp%3B+Presentations&index=1&md5=7381bd60f12febecb16e95e3f87fac01) .


**About Pursuit**


Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) is an attractions and hospitality company that owns and operates a collection of inspiring and unforgettable experiences in iconic destinations in the United States, Canada, Iceland and Costa Rica. Pursuit's elevated hospitality experiences include world-class attractions and distinctive lodges, along with integrated restaurants, retail and transportation that enable visitors to discover and connect with renowned travel locations.[www.pursuit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pursuit.com%2F&esheet=54645875&newsitemid=20261124041337&lan=en-US&anchor=www.pursuit.com&index=2&md5=500c23d8d829cd34fa917efdee2eab39)
